title: K-Rotating
source_topic: ICPC / The 2017 ACM - Asia Ho Chi Minh City Regional Contest
statement: N teachers start in the classes of the same number and are shuffled by rotations: a plan names up to ten teachers and, from a given week on, moves each into the class the next one occupied. Plans arrive in arbitrary week order interleaved with questions asking which class a teacher holds in a given week, counting only plans issued so far. Up to one hundred thousand operations.
